python3 -c "
# Check sofa in obs_0029
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0029.png'))

# Sofa is on the right: col 400 to 480
# Find sofa contact with floor:
sofa_contacts = []
for c in range(410, 480):
    for r in range(420, 360, -1):
        # Sofa is grey [90, 95, 105]
        if abs(int(img[r, c, 0]) - int(img[r, c, 1])) < 10 and img[r, c, 2] > 90 and img[r, c, 0] < 120:
            sofa_contacts.append((c, r))
            break

print('Sofa contacts:', len(sofa_contacts))
if sofa_contacts:
    print('Min c:', min(p[0] for p in sofa_contacts))
    print('Max c:', max(p[0] for p in sofa_contacts))
    for c, r in sofa_contacts[::5]:
        print(f'c={c}: r={r}, rgb={img[r, c]}')
"
